    // generic types should behave as if they have properties of their constraint type
    
    class A {
        foo(): string { return ''; }
    }
    
    class B extends A {
        bar(): string {
            return '';
        }
    }
    
    class C<U extends A, T extends U> {
        f() {
            var x: T;
            // BUG 823818
            var a = x['foo'](); // should be string
            return a + x.foo();
        }
    
        g(x: U) {
            // BUG 823818
            var a = x['foo'](); // should be string
            return a + x.foo();
        }
    }
    
    var r1a = (new C<A, B>()).f();
    var r1b = (new C<A, B>()).g(new B());
